thesis: A sound product business, hurt by fixed costs, priced for a recovery that has only started.

warnings.text: Peer EV/EBITDA is on each company's current price; the history uses fiscal-year average prices.
Q2 FY27 is in the TTM figures but not in the FY26 full-year figures.

panels.question: Should I worry, and about what?
panels.headline: Sound product, hurt by costs, priced ahead

charts.title: Price against earnings
charts.subtitle: Change over the last year, %
charts.alt: Bar chart. The share price rose 82% in a year. EPS fell 68% in the last full year but TTM EPS is 115% above that low base.

lights.label: Business health
lights.reason: Pricing holds, but interest cover is thin and sales are shrinking.

lights.label: Profit trend
lights.reason: EBITDA margin is near its five-year low; TTM shows a recovery.

lights.label: Price vs value
lights.reason: Fair value per share is below today's price in every case.

lights.label: Momentum
lights.reason: Uptrend intact, but late, stretched and thinly traded.

price_vs_earnings.sentence: The share price is behind TTM earnings but far ahead of last full-year earnings.

panels.question: Where did the profit go?
panels.headline: Prices held. Costs broke the margin.

charts.title: Prices held, overheads rose
charts.subtitle: Contribution margin and SG&A as % of revenue; forecasts dashed
charts.alt: Line chart. SG&A rose from 30.7% to 37.8% of revenue between FY22 and FY26 while contribution margin stayed near 46%. The shaded gap between the lines narrowed. Forecasts are dashed.

charts.title: From revenue to EBITDA, FY26
charts.subtitle: Rs crore
charts.alt: Waterfall chart. Revenue of Rs 9,399 crore less Rs 5,053 crore of direct costs leaves Rs 4,346 crore of contribution. SG&A of Rs 3,553 crore leaves EBITDA of Rs 793 crore.

chips.label: Contribution margin
chips.so_what: Revenue swung 33 points but this margin moved 3. Pricing is holding; the profit problem lies in costs below this line.
chips.calc: Contribution profit / revenue, FY22 to FY26. Verdict: top third of own five-year range.

chips.label: SG&A as % of revenue
chips.so_what: Overheads take more of each sale than at any time in five years, which is what squeezes profit when sales fall.
chips.calc: SG&A / revenue. Lower is better. Peer median from the peer set.

chips.label: Operating leverage
chips.so_what: A large share of each lost rupee of sales comes straight out of profit, so earnings swing more than sales.
chips.calc: Change in EBITDA / change in revenue x 100, FY25 to FY26.

bridge.text: EBITDA margin moved -6.2 points from FY22 to FY26: contribution margin +0.9 points, SG&A as % of revenue +7.1 points.

operating_leverage.text: About Rs 44 of every Rs 100 of lost sales came out of EBITDA from FY25 to FY26.

panels.question: Is this a one-off dip?
panels.headline: Second downturn in four years, same pattern.

charts.title: Sales swings drive earnings swings
charts.subtitle: Revenue growth (bars, left axis) and EBITDA (line, right axis)
charts.alt: Combined chart. Revenue fell 13.1% in FY23 and 10.9% in FY26, and EBITDA fell with it from Rs 1,359 crore to Rs 753 crore and from Rs 1,298 crore to Rs 793 crore. The steadiest peer stayed within Rs 1,220 to 1,280 crore.

chips.label: EBITDA margin
chips.so_what: Operating profit per rupee of sales is at its low point, so each further fall in sales hurts earnings sharply.

chips.label: Earnings volatility
chips.so_what: Profit margins swing far more than at the steadiest peers, which makes the earnings path harder to trust.
chips.calc: Range of EBITDA margin over five years, compared with the peer median range.

panels.question: Can it fund itself and carry its debt?
panels.headline: Debt falling; cash strong, partly one-off.

charts.title: Does profit turn into cash?
charts.subtitle: EBITDA and operating cash flow, Rs crore; conversion % above each pair

data.tip: FY22: operating cash flow Rs 587 cr, 43% of EBITDA
FY23: operating cash flow Rs 756 cr, 100% of EBITDA
FY24: operating cash flow Rs 533 cr, 39% of EBITDA
FY25: operating cash flow Rs 688 cr, 53% of EBITDA
FY26: operating cash flow Rs 1,175 cr, 148% of EBITDA
TTM: operating cash flow Rs 1,910 cr, 179% of EBITDA

charts.alt: Paired bar chart of EBITDA and operating cash flow. Cash conversion was 43%, 100%, 39%, 53% and 148% from FY22 to FY26. It rose when sales fell, in FY23 and FY26.

charts.title: Debt to equity
charts.subtitle: Lower is better
charts.alt: Debt to equity: FY22 0.8x, FY26 0.37x. Improving.

chips.label: Cash conversion
chips.so_what: Cash comes in when sales fall and goes out when they rise, so FY26 cash is flattered.
chips.calc: Operating cash flow / EBITDA each year; correlation with revenue growth -0.89.

chips.label: Debt to equity
chips.so_what: Borrowing has fallen steadily, which gives room to ride out a weak year.
chips.calc: Total debt / shareholders' equity, FY22 to FY26.

chips.label: Interest coverage
chips.so_what: Profit covers interest only thinly, so a further earnings dip would strain debt service.
chips.calc: EBIT / interest expense. General norm: below 3x is thin.

notes: Capex is reported separately from other investing cash flow: capex was Rs 799 cr in FY26 and free cash flow Rs 376 cr.

panels.question: Is the price justified?
panels.headline: Priced above its history and steadiest peer.

charts.title: Where the stock sits among peers
charts.subtitle: EV/EBITDA on last full-year EBITDA; peers at their current prices

data.tip: At the report's price of about Rs 129: 16.6x

charts.alt: Dot strip. Peers sit between 11.4x and 26.9x EV/EBITDA with a median of 17.8x. Welspun is at 29.7x at today's price, above every peer; at the report's price of about Rs 129 it was 16.6x.

data.tip: At the report's price of about Rs 129: 16.6x

charts.static_note: At the report's price of about Rs 129, EV/EBITDA was 16.6x.

charts.title: P/E against its own history
charts.subtitle: Band is the five-year range of 18x to 37x

data.tip: P/E on FY26 EPS at today's price: 116.9x
P/E on TTM EPS at today's price: 54.5x

charts.alt: P/E against history. The company's five-year P/E range is 18x to 37x. Today it is 54.5x on trailing 12-month EPS and 116.9x on FY26 EPS.

charts.title: Fair value per share against Rs 249
charts.subtitle: Bands from each forecast case

data.tip: Company model, 12x to 18x FY27E EBITDA: Rs 124 to 186
Peer dataset projection, 12x to 18x: Rs 105 to 155

charts.alt: Price ruler. Fair value bands are Rs 124 to 186 per share on the company model and Rs 105 to 155 on the peer dataset projection. Today's price of Rs 249 is above both.

chips.label: P/E against own history
chips.so_what: The price asks investors to pay well above what they have paid in the past for each rupee of profit.
chips.calc: Price / TTM EPS at the snapshot price against P/E on year-end figures FY22 to FY26.

chips.label: EV/EBITDA against peers
chips.so_what: The market pays more for each rupee of operating profit than for any peer.
chips.calc: (Market cap + net debt) / FY26 EBITDA at today's price; peer median at their current prices.

chips.label: Fair value against price
chips.so_what: Every forecast case values the shares below today's price, so the price assumes more than the model does.
chips.calc: 16x model FY27E EBITDA less net debt, per share; range 12x to 18x.

fair_value_cases.basis: 12x to 18x FY27E EBITDA of Rs 977 cr

fair_value_cases.label: Peer dataset projection
fair_value_cases.basis: 12x to 18x FY27 EBITDA of Rs 780 cr

panels.question: What is the share price doing?
panels.headline: Strong trend, losing force.

charts.title: One year of price
charts.subtitle: With 50- and 200-day averages and volume
charts.alt: Line chart of one year of share price with 50- and 200-day averages and volume bars. The price is above both averages and ended at Rs 249 near its 52-week high.
charts.static_note: Shown: one year. Six-month and two-year views are in the on-screen report.

charts.title: MACD histogram
charts.subtitle: Momentum is fading while price makes new highs
charts.alt: MACD histogram over 60 sessions. The latest peak is lower than the earlier one while price made a higher high, a bearish divergence.

chips.label: Stretch above 200-day average
chips.so_what: The price is far above its long-run average, which has often been followed by a pause.
chips.calc: Price / 200-day average - 1. General norm: above 30% is stretched.

tests.label: Trend
tests.evidence: Price above both averages; golden cross on 1 June.

tests.label: Momentum
tests.measures: RSI and MACD combined, counted once
tests.evidence: RSI 58.9; MACD histogram below its earlier peak.

tests.label: Participation
tests.measures: Volume in this trend vs the prior base
tests.evidence: Median volume is 0.18x the prior base.

extra.verdict_sentence: Uptrend intact, but late, stretched and thinly traded.

divergence.sentence: Bearish divergence: price made a higher high while MACD made a lower high (11.77 to 9.07).

extra.rsi_zone: RSI 58.9 is in the neutral zone (30 to 60).

panels.question: What would change the view?
panels.headline: Three signs the recovery is real.

charts.title: Where each signpost stands
charts.subtitle: Current value against the level that would confirm recovery

data.tip: SG&A 37.8% of revenue now; target below 34%

charts.alt: Bar chart of three signposts against their targets: SG&A 37.8% against a target below 34%, EBITDA margin 10.3% against above 12%, and interest cover 2.8x against above 4x.

chips.label: TTM EBITDA against last full year
chips.so_what: Recent quarters are already earning more than the full year, which is the first sign of recovery.
chips.calc: Sum of the last four reported quarters of EBITDA.

signposts.why: Overheads must fall back for margins to recover.

signposts.threshold_text: Above 12% for two to three quarters
signposts.why: A sustained margin above 12% would confirm the forecast path.
Thin cover leaves little room for another weak year.
Cash should hold up even when working capital absorbs it.

glossary.definition: Enterprise value divided by operating profit before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation. It shows what investors pay for each rupee of operating profit.
Trailing twelve months: the last four reported quarters added together.
Selling, general and administrative costs: overheads that do not change directly with each unit sold.
Earnings per share: profit after tax divided by the number of shares.
Relative strength index, a 0 to 100 gauge of recent price momentum. Above 70 is overbought, below 30 oversold.
A momentum gauge built from two moving averages of price.
Price divided by earnings per share.

sources.snapshot: Price as of the 13 Nov 2026 close; market cap from the exchange quote.
definitions: Net debt is borrowings less cash and current investments at the latest balance sheet.
Enterprise value is market cap plus net debt.
